Name: Shemaiah, Son of Hasshub
Summary: Son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari, dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:14: Son of Hasshub son of Azrikam son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari, dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shemaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
